scope: Authored location inventory and art planning only; this is not a gameplay, render, import, performance, or multiplayer certification.
implementationRequirements: Resolve art by AuthoredLocationId, not the legacy runtime LocationState.Id; for example runtime L006 is authored L003 Woodland Clearing.
Use reusable biome modules plus each row's authored points of interest; a shared forest/tree fallback alone is not full location coverage.
Create one explicit presentation catalog entry for every L000-L235; track generic fallback and dedicated landmark coverage separately.
Load only active-quest/revealed-location art and release old quest roots; do not render 236 complete environments simultaneously.
Keep imported colliders/root motion/demo controllers from changing server-owned movement, combat, save identity, or quest rules.
Validate materials/scale/LOD/lighting/navigation and two-client visibility before marking any imported preset passing.
Keep raw licensed Store packages outside the public repository; commit integration code and acquisition/coverage metadata.
